notes: This registry is separate from the historical BugsInPy CASE_REGISTRY.json.
The 96-row metadata cohort is a screening order only. No row is accepted automatically.

Do not insert candidate records into this registry until exact-base and changed-file license/provenance review, exposure and independence review, buggy-fail/fixed-pass reproduction, Panel A ground truth review, and Panel B evidence sufficiency review are independently documented.

Any candidate previously used to debug/calibrate the screening or runner pipeline, or opened for target-test troubleshooting before prospective protocol assignment, is permanently excluded. Planned technical reproduction under the frozen protocol is permitted only by designated source-exposed personnel who are excluded from Panel B and the confirmatory analyst role; all source exposure is logged.
Panel A and Panel B reviewer identities must be disjoint. Preserve original independent ratings and adjudication records.
No model response may be used to define ground truth or E1/E2/E3.

The acceptance schema and validator check structural completeness and cross-field consistency only; they do not authenticate referenced artifacts, establish legal conclusions, inspect source code, or substitute for human semantic adjudication.
Technical reproducibility, exact-source licensing, Panel A gold review, and Panel B blinded evidence-tier review are separate records and must use disjoint reviewers as enforced by the validator.
A successful structural check is not proof that a case is scientifically valid. Referenced artifacts and reviewer attestations require independent external audit before data collection.

The case-level exposure record must list every source/gold-exposed person; Panel B and the confirmatory analyst must be unexposed. Role declarations are structural checks and require independent audit.
